sources: https://book.wvstateparks.com/Ecomm/Listings/SupplierTile/7816932/en-US?supplierId=7989221 and ?supplierId=11068527 (stays 2026-10-27 to 2027-06-20, unit names, prices and unit-amenity tags, read 2026-10-21 with audit/state_park_fees/wv_tiles.py)

values.note: Booking site, Oct 2026 to Jun 2027, weeknights and a Friday-Saturday stay alike: five non-electric sites (38-42) $34.99 a night, tagged as fitting a 20-30 ft RV; electric sites $44.99, sites 25 and 26 $59.99.

fees.source: book.wvstateparks.com supplier 7989221 'Tomlinson Run State Park Non-electric Campsites' (Sites 38-42, $34.99 on 2026-10-27, 2027-05-11, 2027-06-15 and 2027-06-18/20; tag '20’ to 30’ RV') + supplier 11068527 'Tomlinson Run State Park Electric Campsites' (38 sites $44.99, sites 25/26 $59.99), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two nights minimum on Friday+Saturday, one night allowed Sunday-Thursday: the booking site sold one-night Tuesday stays (Oct 2026, May and Jun 2027) and offered nothing for a one-night Friday or Saturday.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/tomlinson-run-state-park/lodging/camping-at-tomlinson-run-state-park/ ('Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday and Saturday) or one night Sunday through Thursday.'; 'There is a 14-night maximum stay.') + book.wvstateparks.com suppliers 7989221/11068527 (one night 2027-06-18 and 2027-06-19: none), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'open spring through fall, weather permitting' (no dates).

hookups.source: book.wvstateparks.com supplier 11068527 (electric sites tagged 30 Amp, seven of them also 50 Amp; no site tagged Water or Sewage Hookup), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 48 traditional campsites, 'all suitable for tents and trailers', plus five camper cabins and a rustic Scout area. The booking site tags 11 sites pull-through and gives RV-length classes from '20’ to 30’ RV' (three sites to the '40’ to 50’ RV' class).

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/tomlinson-run-state-park/lodging/camping-at-tomlinson-run-state-park/ ('The campground includes 48 traditional campsites and five camper cabins'; 'All campsites are suitable for tents and trailers') + book.wvstateparks.com suppliers 7989221/11068527 (Pull Thru Site and RV-length tags), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Contact station, convenience store, dump station and two bathhouses with showers and laundry.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/tomlinson-run-state-park/lodging/camping-at-tomlinson-run-state-park/ ('has a contact station, convenience store, dump station and two bathhouses with showers and laundry facilities'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Park page + booking site: fees $34.99 non-electric (+$10 electric) confirmed, non-electric sites tagged as fitting RVs; inherited booking rules (2-night weekend minimum, 14-night max) confirmed into the entry, one-night weeknights sell; added 50-amp, 48 sites with pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump/store, spring-fall season. Water/sewer at the site not stated.
